title: Omega1312's Forge
description: Custom Name Skins for Tools! Made by Me!
body:
![Title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/746b497c6b9ed4f1d957a24e5d67b3e6b4f37016.png)

#  Summery
This is a pack I made for my friends. If you found this page, you can use it too, but I doubt it will be of any use to you! 
The way it works is when you rename items to certain things on anvils, it changes the weapon skin.
Maybe at some point I'll add more public ones
I'll give you one: "Void's Hammer " (On the Mace) (Yes this is one I made while testing the concept, so it doesn't look the coolest)
Have Fun!

![One of the weapons added, and me looking rather ominous](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fb1f7291ce2ef8d62ace0c2ef0e383f78d24456.png)
- Adds many custom weapon skins that can be found by changing the name of the item
- If the game gives a warning about unknown version or something, it is fine. I just don't know how to fix that.
